title: Superhost Response Bonus on Roamhaven Travel Credits (Host Accounts)
content:
# Superhost Perk Q&A — The Response Bonus on a Travel Credit (Host Accounts)

**What is the response bonus?**
A Roamhaven travel credit of a Host Accounts Superhost also carries a response bonus:

- **USD 25.00** when the response rates recorded at the account's Superhost assessments recorded as met and dated within the 12 months before the credit average at least **92.0%**;
- **USD 10.00** when they average at least **88.0%** but less than 92.0%;
- no response bonus otherwise.

The response bonus is added to the base amount and the stays bonus before that sum is rounded.

**Which assessments are averaged?**
Only the Superhost assessments recorded as met, dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the date of the credit. Assessments recorded as not met are left out.

**What happens exactly at 92.0% or 88.0%?**
An average equal to the figure reaches it: 92.0% exactly earns USD 25.00, 88.0% exactly earns USD 10.00, 87.99% earns no response bonus.

**A worked case?**
Hypothetically, four met assessments in the 12 months recorded 93.50%, 91.00%, 92.00% and 90.50%. They average 91.75%: at least 88.0% but less than 92.0%, so the response bonus is USD 10.00.
